channel.title: RangerTrak Field Notes
channel.description: A short series introducing RangerTrak, the free offline radio log and map for CERT, ACS/ARES and SAR command posts.

item.title: RangerTrak Beta 3: What's New
item.description: Release notes for RangerTrak 1.0.0-beta.3: field phones keep a list, My reports, and take receipts from the command post; ICS-213RR resource requests on FEMA's form; the ranger's notes in map popups; a setup guide for RangerView; and Leaflet 2.0.0-beta.4 under the map.

item.title: What You Said You'd Fix: AAR Notes in FEMA's HSEEP Shape
item.description: RangerTrak's AAR notes now take FEMA HSEEP's capability element (POETE), and the printed improvement plan is modeled on the HSEEP AAR/IP, so a CERT, ACS or SAR group's hot-wash notes fit a county exercise's improvement plan without retyping.

item.title: RangerTrak Beta 2: What's New
item.description: Release notes for RangerTrak 1.0.0-beta.2: the map moves to Leaflet 2 with a fullscreen button, one Show on map box with a heat map and range rings, clue headings, the RangerTrak SitRep, a version on every printout, and a web zip and Board kit on every release.

item.title: After the Mission: Summaries, AAR and the Final Report
item.description: Part 9 of Field Notes: the debrief summary, AAR notes as an improvement-plan table, the ICS-214 on FEMA's form, the roster changes for your coordinator, and clearing the laptop without losing the record.

item.title: RangerTrak Beta: What Changed Since the Alpha
item.description: Release notes: RangerTrak is in beta, version 1.0.0-beta.1. 97 releases in four weeks, in the order a mission runs, and a hands-on tour to try them.

item.title: Shift Change: Op Periods, Scribes and Laptops
item.description: Part 8: the end of an operational period. A two-minute brief for the next scribe, the period's 309 communications log and ICS-214 on paper, and the log moved to another laptop without a lost or doubled entry.

item.title: Your Roster Is Already in a Spreadsheet
item.description: Part 7: bring the Excel or CSV lists your group already keeps into RangerTrak, see what will change before anything does, and never lose a phone number to a blank cell.

item.title: What's Missing, and Who Decides
item.description: Part 6: the gaps I haven't closed yet, stated plainly, the commitments that won't change, and an invitation to put RangerTrak through a real tabletop.

item.title: More Than One Laptop
item.description: Part 5: a ranger's own phone sending its reports home, a Report Packet that only ever adds, setup files for a new device, and an optional live view for the command post.

item.title: From Radio Log to Form 309 and ICS-213
item.description: Part 4: correcting the Radio Log as you go, why a note is not a message, and printing the same reports onto FEMA's own ICS-213 and a real Form 309 Communications Log.

item.title: However They Read It Out
item.description: Part 3: positions in whatever format the radio gives you, converted on the device with no signal, the pin-in-the-water check, and the two maps that both work offline.

item.title: Hot, Warm, Cold
item.description: Part 2: the five minutes of preparation that decide whether RangerTrak works when the network goes down, and an airplane-mode test to run on your own device. Published with the alpha.

item.title: The Paper Log, Without the Paper
item.description: Part 1: what RangerTrak is, who it's for, a ten-minute tour with demo data, and what I need to hear from people who run real radio nets.
